question: When you hear the siren of an emergency vehicle, you should

options.text: Stop immediately where you are in order to make way.
Pull over to the left or right side of the road.
Sound your horn to warn the front vehicles to speed up.

question: When you hear the siren of an emergency vehicle but are not sure where it is coming from, you should

options.text: Continue to drive at the same speed.
Move to the side and stop if necessary.
Drive faster so as not to obstruct the emergency vehicle.

question: After driving through flood the brakes may malfunction. In order to correct this, you must

options.text: Stop the vehicle on a slope to allow water to flow out from the brakes.
Pump the brake pedal repeatedly to dry the brakes.
Drive at normal speed to spin-dry the brakes.

question: On a two-lane carriageway, you should

options.text: Keep to the left lane.
Keep to the outer lane.
Not overtake another vehicle.

question: All drivers are required by law to switch on the vehicle's headlights whilst driving between

options.text: 7.00 pm and 7.00 am.
7.15 pm and 7.15 am.
7.30 pm and 7.30 am.

question: Switching on the headlights whilst driving in heavy rain during the daytime

options.text: Is advisable because you can be readily seen by others.
Is not advisable because it will shorten the battery life.
Is not advisable because the rain water will reflect the light.

question: At night, when approaching a sharp left bend you should

options.text: Flash your headlights to attract the attention of other road user.
Speed up so as to pass the danger as quickly as possible.
Keep more to the right to have a better view.

notes: Option A reads 'other road user' (singular) in the source, likely meant 'users'.

question: The right most outer lane on a three-lane carriageway is for

options.text: Emergency vehicles and overtaking only.
Vehicles travelling at the maximum speed limit of the road.
Vehicles which are capable of travelling at high speed.

notes: Source writes 'right most' as two words.

question: During bus lane prohibited hours, motorist is allowed to use the bus lane when

options.text: It is empty.
The other lanes are congested.
The driver is trying to avoid a collision.

question: A passenger is exempted from wearing a seat belt if he is below

options.text: 1.7 metres in height.
1.6 metres in height.
1.5 metres in height.

question: This sign means you
picture: Blue sign with a white curved arrow turning left and 'Left Turn On Red', above a yellow plate reading 'STOP Before turning'

options.text: Can turn left immediately upon reaching the junction.
Must stop and give way before turning left.
Need not stop and check as you have the right of way.

question: This sign means
picture: Blue circular sign with a white arrow pointing straight up

options.text: One way traffic ahead - vehicles may turn right or left.
Drive straight ahead only - vehicles are not allowed to turn right or left.
Steep slope ahead - drive carefully and do not overtake.

question: This sign means 'No Entry' for vehicles
picture: Red-bordered circular sign showing '4.5m' between a downward and an upward pointing black arrowhead

options.text: With overall height exceeding 4.5 metres.
With overall width exceeding 4.5 metres.
With overall length exceeding 4.5 metres.

question: This sign means
picture: Red-bordered circular sign with two black cars side by side, crossed by a red diagonal line

options.text: You cannot park abreast another car.
'No Entry' for motor cars.
You cannot overtake another vehicle.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangular warning sign with two black vertical lines that curve inward towards each other near the top

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop - road ends ahead.
Slow down and drive carefully - dual-carriageway ahead.
Slow down, do not overtake - road narrows ahead.

question: When you see this sign, you should
picture: Red triangular warning sign with three black curved arrows forming a circle

options.text: Slow down and give way to traffic on the right.
Slow down and give way to traffic on the left.
Not slow down at all.

question: This sign means
picture: Red triangular warning sign with a black shape: a single thick bar at the top splitting into two separate bars below

options.text: Two lanes are merging - alternative vehicles have the right of way.
You must make a U-turn as the road is ending ahead.
You should slow down, keep left and beware of oncoming traffic.

notes: Option A reads 'alternative vehicles' in the source, likely meant 'alternate'.

question: This sign means
picture: Red triangular warning sign with the black letters 'ERP'

options.text: Electronic Road Patrol ahead.
Electronic Road Pricing zone ahead.
Electronic Report Panel ahead.

question: This sign indicates
picture: Plain red triangle with a white centre and no symbol, not mounted on a post

options.text: That there is a broken down vehicle ahead - slow down and drive carefully.
That you should change lane and drive faster so as not to obstruct other traffic.
You may drive on at any speed because the road ahead is clear.

question: This designated shelter is for
picture: Blue square sign with a white umbrella and a raindrop

options.text: Motor-car drivers.
Motor-cyclists.
Pedestrians.
